name: @ops/control-plane
description: Control Plane service - API Gateway for Browser Control Plane

scripts.start: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const main=['dist/main.js','dist/src/main.js','dist/apps/backend/execution-control/control-plane/src/main.js','dist/app/src/main.js'].find(f=>fs.existsSync(f)); if(!main){console.error('No main.js found in dist');process.exit(1);} require('./'+main);"
scripts.start:prod: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const main=['dist/main.js','dist/src/main.js','dist/apps/backend/execution-control/control-plane/src/main.js','dist/app/src/main.js'].find(f=>fs.existsSync(f)); if(!main){console.error('No main.js found in dist');process.exit(1);} require('./'+main);"
scripts.start:worker: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const main=['dist/worker-main.js','dist/src/worker-main.js','dist/apps/backend/execution-control/control-plane/src/worker-main.js','dist/app/src/worker-main.js'].find(f=>fs.existsSync(f)); if(!main){console.error('No worker-main.js found in dist');process.exit(1);} require('./'+main);"
